fields.name: dmImage
fields.label: Dynamic Media Image URL
fields.description: Paste the Dynamic Media asset URL (e.g. https://media-assets.stryker.com/is/image/stryker/NAME?$preset$). Authored as a link so Edge Delivery does not rehost it; rendered as a responsive <picture> at load.

fields.name: dmImageAlt
fields.label: Alt Text
fields.description: Accessible description of the image (becomes the rendered ).
